name: Montana

agency.name: Montana Department of Justice, Motor Vehicle Division

gaps: Montana has no sales tax, but each county may levy a local option motor vehicle tax of up to 0.7% of the depreciated MSRP, or a flat fee. Only the Yellowstone County rate (0.5%) was read on an official page; for every other county the line shows the legal range from $0 to 0.7%.

The county option tax is based on the MSRP; when you do not type it, the engine uses the price, which understates the tax on a used car. Pickups and SUVs registered as trucks use the truck column of the depreciation table (the law has a separate, slightly different sport utility column).
Vehicles 17 years old or more are depreciated a further 10% a year from the 16-year value until $500; the engine keeps the 16-year percentage for them.
The light truck gross vehicle weight fee depends on the rated capacity (1/2, 3/4 or 1 ton), which the form does not ask; it is shown as a range.
The 3% MVD administrative fee is applied to the state fees and donations, not to the county option tax; the law charges it on all fees and donations under Title 61.
The first registration of a new car may cover 13 to 24 months depending on the period the county assigns; the engine shows one year.
No dealer documentation fee cap was read in Montana law for this release.

summary.taxName: no sales tax (county option tax on value)
summary.docFeeNote: No cap read in Montana law for this release; type the dealer's fee.
summary.inspectionWhere: Montana has no periodic safety or emissions inspection for private passenger cars.

params._src: mca-reg (61-3-321 fees), mca-title (61-3-203), mca-ev (61-3-572, 61-3-571, 61-3-573), mca-option (61-3-537), mca-value (61-3-503 table), mca-permanent (61-3-562), mca-admin (61-3-111), yellowstone (county rate 0.5%, GVW fees)

singular: At registration a Montana owner pays the registration fee in lieu of tax, any county option tax and the listed donations; no sales tax is charged on the purchase [mca-303].
The yearly registration fee depends only on age: $217 up to 4 years old, $87 from 5 to 10 years and $28 from 11 years [mca-reg].
A car 11 years old or more can be registered permanently for an $87.50 fee plus five years of county option tax, and the permanent registration ends when the car is sold [mca-permanent].
Light vehicles with an MSRP over $150,000 pay an extra $825 a year until they are 10 years old [mca-reg].
Counties may add a local option tax of up to 0.7% of the depreciated MSRP, and Yellowstone County charges 0.5% [yellowstone].
The taxable value follows a statutory table: a new car is valued at 90% of its MSRP in its model year, 80% the next year and 49% at four years old, never below $500 [mca-value].
Electric cars under 6,000 lb pay $130 a year on top of registration and plug-in hybrids $70; hybrids that do not plug in pay nothing extra [mca-ev].
Every registration carries a $10 Highway Patrol fee and a $9 state parks fee that owners may decline [mca-reg].
The Motor Vehicle Division adds a 3% administrative fee to the fees and donations it collects [mca-admin].
A light vehicle title costs $12 until June 30, 2028, when it drops to $7 [mca-title].

mca-reg.name: Montana Code Annotated 2025, 61-3-321 (registration fees)
mca-reg.quote: (i) if the vehicle is 4 or less years old, $217; (ii) if the vehicle is 5 through 10 years old, $87; and (iii) if the vehicle is 11 or more years old, $28. ... a fee of $12 must be collected when a new set of standard license plates ... is issued

mca-title.name: Montana Code Annotated 2025, 61-3-203 (title fee)
mca-title.quote: Until June 30, 2028, a person applying for a certificate of title shall pay ... (b) $12 if the vehicle for which application is made is a light vehicle or a truck or bus that weighs 1 ton or less.

mca-303.name: Montana Code Annotated 2025, 61-3-303 (original registration, donations)
mca-303.quote: a person registering a motor vehicle shall pay ... the fees in lieu of tax or registration fees as required for: (i) a light vehicle under 61-3-321 or 61-3-562, in addition to, if applicable, any local option tax or fee under 61-3-537 ... an automatic donation of $1

mca-ev.name: Montana Code Annotated 2025, 61-3-572 (additional electric vehicle registration fees)
mca-ev.quote: The annual registration fees for electric vehicles other than plug-in hybrid electric vehicles is as follows: (a) $130 for class 1 vehicles; (b) $190 for class 2 vehicles ... plug-in hybrid electric vehicles ... (a) $70 for class 1 vehicles; (b) $100

mca-ev-class.name: Montana Code Annotated 2025, 61-3-571 (definitions) and 61-3-573 (permanent EV fee)
mca-ev-class.quote: "Class 1 vehicle" means a vehicle having an unladen gross weight of less than 6,000 pounds.

mca-option.name: Montana Code Annotated 2025, 61-3-537 (local option motor vehicle tax)
mca-option.quote: A county may impose a local option motor vehicle tax on motor vehicles subject to the registration fee imposed under 61-3-321(2) or 61-3-562 at a rate of up to 0.7% of the value determined under 61-3-503 or a local flat fee

mca-value.name: Montana Code Annotated 2025, 61-3-503 (assessment, depreciation table)
mca-value.quote: the depreciated value for the taxation of light vehicles is computed by multiplying the manufacturer's suggested retail price by a percentage multiplier based on the type and age of the light vehicle ... If the depreciated value is less than $500, the department shall value the motor vehicle at $500.

mca-permanent.name: Montana Code Annotated 2025, 61-3-562 (permanent registration)
mca-permanent.quote: The owner of a light vehicle 11 years old or older ... may permanently register the light vehicle upon payment of an $87.50 registration fee ... and an amount equal to five times the local option motor vehicle tax ... The permanent registration ... may not be transferred to a new owner.

mca-admin.name: Montana Code Annotated 2025, 61-3-111 (administrative fee)
mca-admin.quote: The motor vehicle division of the department shall charge, impose, and collect a 3% administrative fee on all fees and donations charged under 23-2-809, 23-2-617, and this title

yellowstone.name: Yellowstone County Treasurer, Motor Vehicle Tax & Fee Schedules
yellowstone.quote: The County Option Tax is calculated at one half percent of the taxable value of the vehicle ... 3% fee assessed on all MVD financial transaction ... MHP Salary and Retention Fee $10.00 ... Light MV FWP Park Fee (Optional) $9.00 ... 1/2 ton = $7.00
